data.description: 【泥岩 · 雪原行军】风雪呼啸的莱塔尼亚荒原之上，穿着全套厚重萨卡兹战甲的泥岩单手扛着比人还高的巨型破城战锤，在及膝的深雪中迈着如山岳般坚实沉稳的步伐。她回头确认同伴的距离——「大家跟紧我。只要我的护盾还在，就没有任何风雪与敌人能伤到你们。」
data.promptProse: Mudrock carries the engineering warhammer, taller than herself, over one shoulder as she walks through knee-deep snow and looks back to check her off-frame companions. Pale snow-reflected light catches the armor edges.
data.title: 泥岩 · 雪原行军
data.identityProseOverride: Mudrock from Arknights, enclosed in her sealed heavy armor and helmet.
data.animaCaption: She looks back toward off-frame companions while carrying the taller-than-herself warhammer.
